summary.business_type: Affiliate content / publisher (pet gadgets niche, Brazilian Portuguese)
top_findings: Critical: AggregateRating on coleira-seresto-antipulgas (4.8*, 5501 reviews) looks copied from a marketplace rather than on-site collected -- manual action risk
High: head commercial queries (melhor antipulgas, comedouro automatico, coleira gps) lose to marketplaces and 5-10 item listicles with tables/photos -- page format/breadth mismatch
High: no first-hand product experience signals (site admits reviews start from vendor photos/specs) -- E-E-A-T Experience ceiling
Medium: Organization schema sameAs is empty despite the Facebook page being live
Medium: llms.txt lists only 5 static pages, omitting all 70+ articles
quick_wins: Populate Organization.sameAs with the live Facebook page URL
Remove the copied AggregateRating on coleira-seresto-antipulgas
Trim the melhor-antipulgas-para-cachorro meta description from 221 to ~155 chars
Fix the /autores/ index 403 (individual author page works, hub page doesn't)
Expand or retire llms.txt to represent the actual article catalog

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTP->HTTPS and www->non-www both clean single-hop 301s to canonical https://smartpetgadgets.com.br/
HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy headers present
robots.txt well-formed with granular per-bot Content-Signal directives, correctly disallows /reports/
Sitemap live, 77 URLs, no orphaned/blocked pages
Fully static server-rendered HTML, no SPA/JS-rendering risk
Canonicals self-referential and consistent, no noindex found

findings.title: IndexNow protocol not implemented
findings.description: No IndexNow submission on publish/update, relying on standard crawl discovery.
findings.recommendation: Implement IndexNow ping on publish/update for faster Bing/Yandex pickup (Bing Copilot surface benefits directly).

findings.title: CSP is minimal
findings.recommendation: Tighten CSP directives incrementally; low priority given static-site low attack surface.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Every article opens with a direct-answer sentence + Key Takeaways block
Valid BlogPosting/Product/FAQ/Breadcrumb JSON-LD
Dated, attributable stats (e.g. 5.501 avaliacoes, retrieved 2026-09-14)
Affiliate disclosure, veterinary caveats, named Person author with bio
No AI-phrasing watermark tells; natural BR-PT prose
Zero content templating (site_risk low, templated_ratio 0.0)

findings.title: No first-hand product experience signals
findings.description: The /sobre/ page admits reviews start from vendor photos/specs, not hands-on testing. This caps the Experience pillar of E-E-A-T (scored 55/100).
findings.recommendation: Add real hands-on signals (owned-unit photos, usage notes, video) where feasible, or explicitly reframe posts as comparative spec analysis rather than implied hands-on reviews.

findings.title: Several articles are thin
findings.description: 4 sampled articles run 500-903 words against a higher coverage floor seen elsewhere on the site (1,390-1,430 words).
findings.recommendation: Expand or consolidate thin satellite articles into their pillar pages.

findings.title: Organization schema sameAs is empty
findings.description: Homepage Organization JSON-LD has sameAs: [] despite the Facebook page (@smartpetgadgetsbr) being live.
findings.recommendation: Add the Facebook URL now; add other profiles as they go live.

findings.title: /autores/ index returns 403
findings.description: Individual author page (/autores/nildo-alves/) returns 200, but the author index/hub returns 403, breaking author-entity navigation.
findings.recommendation: Fix server config or remove the broken hub link if not needed.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, descriptive, keyword-led title tags (53-75 chars) on all samples
H1 present exactly once per page, distinct from title
Unique meta descriptions on all samples
Clean, keyword-descriptive URL slugs

findings.title: Meta description over length on at least one article
findings.description: melhor-antipulgas-para-cachorro meta description is 221 characters, well past Google's ~155-160 char practical truncation point.
findings.recommendation: Trim to ~150-160 chars; run a length sweep across all 76 URLs since similar comparison-style posts likely share the pattern.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: BlogPosting, Person, Organization, BreadcrumbList well-formed across all 76 pages
No missing required properties, no deprecated types
JSON-LD, https, absolute-URL, ISO-date best practices followed throughout

findings.title: AggregateRating on coleira-seresto-antipulgas looks copied from a marketplace
findings.description: 4.8-star / 5,501-review AggregateRating appears sourced from a third-party marketplace rather than collected on-site -- a Google manual-action risk (misrepresented structured data policy).
findings.recommendation: Remove the AggregateRating block; keep the editorial Review-only schema, matching the pattern already used on the other 7 product pages.

findings.title: FAQPage schema has zero current SERP value
findings.description: 71/76 pages carry FAQPage schema, but per Google's 2026-05-07 policy update, FAQ rich results are no longer shown site-wide (not just gov/health as originally rolled out).
findings.recommendation: No removal needed (harmless), but stop reporting FAQPage as an SEO asset internally -- it no longer earns SERP real estate.

findings.title: sameAs empty / Review.author type inconsistent
findings.description: Homepage Organization.sameAs is []; Review.author alternates between Person and Organization across product pages.
findings.recommendation: Populate sameAs with live social profiles; standardize Review.author type across all product review posts.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: LCP: 0.9-2.0s across homepage + 2 sampled articles, well under 2.5s Good threshold
Total Blocking Time: 0ms on every sampled page (strong INP proxy)
CLS: 0.0 on all three sampled pages

findings.title: CrUX field data unavailable (403)
findings.description: Both CrUX single-period and 25-week-history API calls returned 403 -- likely the API isn't enabled for the configured GCP project, not a site issue. May also reflect insufficient real-user traffic volume for CrUX's reporting threshold.
findings.recommendation: Check Google Cloud Console CrUX API enablement; re-check once organic traffic volume grows.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% alt-text coverage on all sampled pages (homepage's 71 images + both sampled articles)
loading=lazy applied consistently on homepage cards
width/height set on homepage cards, preventing CLS
WebP used on many hero images

findings.title: Uneven image count per article
findings.description: melhor-antipulgas-para-cachorro has only 4 images across ~1,656 words; coleira-gps-para-pet has just 1 -- thin relative to competing marketplace/listicle SERPs showing 5-10 product photos (see SXO finding).
findings.recommendation: Add 1 product image per compared item when rebuilding head-term pages into fuller listicles.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Lighthouse Agentic Browsing: 3/3 mobile and desktop (accessibility-tree, CLS, llms.txt checks pass)
Agent-UX accessibility-tree heuristic: 100/100, 220 clean interactive nodes, 0 unnamed elements
Deliberate, consistent Content-Signal policy across all 16 crawler groups (search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no)
Static SSR HTML fully visible to non-JS-executing AI crawlers

findings.title: llms.txt omits the article catalog
findings.description: llms.txt lists only 5 static pages (Home, Sobre, Contato, Politica editorial, Autores), omitting all 70+ published articles that AI search bots are explicitly allowed to cite.
findings.recommendation: Expand llms.txt to list key pillar/cluster pages (10-20 highest-value URLs), or retire it as a maintained artifact -- it carries no Google Search ranking weight either way.

findings.title: No verified brand-mention footprint beyond own domain
findings.description: No confirmed Wikipedia, Reddit, YouTube, or LinkedIn presence. Brand mentions correlate 3x more strongly with AI citations than backlinks (Ahrefs Dec 2025 study).
findings.recommendation: Start with YouTube (highest citation correlation) leveraging existing content assets; populate Organization.sameAs as profiles go live.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Remove the copied AggregateRating on /coleira-seresto-antipulgas/ (manual-action risk)
Populate Organization.sameAs with the live Facebook page URL

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Rebuild head-commercial-term pages (melhor-antipulgas-para-cachorro, comedouro-automatico-para-pet, melhor-coleira-gps-sem-mensalidade) as fuller ranked listicles (5-8 items) with an above-fold comparison table and clear 'Ver preco' CTAs -- close the format gap against marketplace/listicle SERPs
Add product images per compared item on rebuilt listicle pages
Trim the melhor-antipulgas-para-cachorro meta description to ~155 chars; sweep all 76 URLs for the same over-length pattern
Expand thin satellite articles (500-903 words) into their pillar pages

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add real hands-on product-experience signals (owned-unit photos, usage notes) where feasible, or explicitly reframe as comparative spec analysis
Build brand-mention footprint starting with YouTube, leveraging existing content/images
Expand llms.txt to represent the real article catalog (or retire it)
Implement IndexNow for faster Bing/Yandex pickup

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Re-check CrUX API enablement in Google Cloud Console; re-pull field CWV data once traffic grows
Track 'cerca virtual para cachorro' (currently position 11.1) as the closest page-1 breakout candidate
Re-run GSC Search Analytics monthly to track position/CTR movement on head-term pages post-rebuild
Standardize Review.author schema type across all product review posts
